mentions.name: Local history map webapp
mentions.description: This webapp maps local history, so opening it wherever you are immediately surfaces cool or interesting history that happened nearby. It depends on historical societies to contribute points of interest and stories, partnerships the builder is still establishing.
mentions.source_excerpt: Want to put local history on a map, so when I go somewhere I could ideally just open this webapp and immediately get presented with cool or interesting history that happened close by.
